facts.claim: The Hyderabad (Deccan) Mining Company issued 85,000 shares, of which about 55,000 were sold to the public.
facts.quote: Of the 85,000 shares issued as fully- paid, about 55,000 were sold to the public.

facts.claim: The company’s share prices ranged between 13 and 5 between September 1886 and April 1888.
facts.quote: The prices of the shares ranged during the period between September, 1886, and April, 1888, fi-om 13| to 5|.

facts.claim: The company was mining in the Singareni coalfields, producing about 150 tons a week.
facts.quote: The Company have been carrying on mining operations in the Singareni coalfields to the extent of raising about 150 tons a week.
